name: Political Science
notes: Requirements apply to the Class of 2021 and later; earlier classes may follow the old requirements, which are not modeled.
At least five of the six courses must be PSCI or INTR courses taken in residence at the University of Rochester. None may be taken S/F.
Courses used for tools of political analysis cannot also satisfy the core track or breadth - the app keeps groups disjoint by default, so this holds.

No more than two introductory courses may count. In most departments all 100-level courses are introductory; in History only a specific list is (HIST 102, 103, 104, 120, 121, 134, 135, 140, 141, 150, 151, 160, 161, 176, 183, 184). Modeled as the program-wide max100Level of 2.
Transfer courses may not satisfy tools of political analysis, and no more than one transfer course may be used. PSCI/INTR 394A is treated as in-residence, not transfer.
AP American or Comparative Government (4-5) or Higher Level IB Global Politics (5-7) grants four credits, counted as introductory and transfer; only one exam may be credited.
College overlap policy: no more than two courses may overlap between a minor and a major or another minor.

requirementGroups.label: Tools of political analysis (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Tools of Political Analysis (Two Courses). Courses used to satisfy tools of political analysis cannot also be used to satisfy requirements for the core track, breadth, or electives. PSCI 107: Introduction to Positive Political Theory; PSCI 200: Data Analysis I; PSCI 202W: Argument in Political Science; PSCI 203W: Survey Research Methods; PSCI 205: Data Analysis II; PSCI 281: Formal Models in Political Science; PSCI 288: Game Theory

requirementGroups.label: Core track (3 courses from one track)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Core Track (Three Courses from One Track): Data and Modeling; Elections and Government; Philosophy, Law, and Public Policy; Political Economy and Development; Race, Ethnicity, and Identity; War, Violence, and Cooperation

requirementGroups.label: Breadth (1 course outside your core track)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Breadth (One Courses). Select one track course that is not in your core track.
